title: Laser mole removal
what: The doctor removes a mole or skin growth with a laser, using local numbing. It is always examined first.
why: When a mole gets in the way, is rubbed by clothes, or you do not like it, and the doctor has confirmed it can be removed by laser.
duration: the procedure usually takes 10 to 30 minutes; healing usually takes 1 to 3 weeks
tell_doctor: If the mole has changed: grown, changed color, or bled
A tendency to form keloid scars

prepare.title: Exam
prepare.text: Before removal, a dermatologist always checks the mole with a dermatoscope. Suspicious moles are removed surgically and sent for testing.

prepare.title: Sun
prepare.text: For 1 to 2 weeks before, do not tan.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: On the day, do not put cream or makeup on the area.

bring: The dermatologist's report, if you were examined earlier
steps: The skin is cleaned with antiseptic
A numbing injection or cream is applied
The laser removes the mole layer by layer
The spot is treated and sometimes covered with a bandage
feel: During the laser: warmth and a smell, but no pain
after: A scab will form on the spot. Do not pick it off
Care for the spot as your doctor said
For a few days, do not scrub the spot or steam it
Protect the spot from the sun for a few months
red_flags: The spot becomes very red, swollen, or has pus
Bleeding that does not stop with pressure

faq.q: Can any mole be removed by laser?
faq.a: No. A doctor examines it first. Suspicious moles are removed with a scalpel and sent for testing.
Usually a small light spot remains, and it fades over time.

reminders.text: Mole removal tomorrow. Do not put cream on the area and do not tan.
